protocol:
1. Put on blue nitrile gloves at the laboratory bench before handling sample tubes and equipment.

2. Cleared the central bench area and positioned the working materials within reach, including a blue microcentrifuge tube rack, small tubes, and nearby benchtop equipment.

3. Moved the blue microcentrifuge tube rack to the right-side work area beside a small benchtop centrifuge.

4. Handled the microcentrifuge tubes in the rack by opening, arranging, and preparing them for processing.

5. Opened the lid of the benchtop centrifuge next to the tube rack.

6. Loaded small tubes into the centrifuge rotor and adjusted their placement by hand.

7. Closed the centrifuge lid after placing the tubes inside.

8. Operated the benchtop centrifuge from the front panel area while the tube rack remained on the bench nearby.

9. Opened or handled the centrifuged tubes after processing and returned them to the blue tube rack.

10. Continued handling the tubes in the rack, including opening and closing tube caps and organizing the samples on the bench.

11. Reached to the central bench area to pick up an additional item or reagent container from the work surface.

12. Returned to the tube rack and continued processing the microcentrifuge tubes at the right-side bench station.
